scope: Compiled CSharp scalar policy source authority, generated SLG declaration parity and automatic runtime expectations; no production compiler source changed.
structure: SelfHostPolicyAttribute connects compiled CSharp classes to canonical SLG module and source/output paths. SelfHostPolicyCompiler derives scalar tables from compiled methods and checks source fingerprints.
branches: Exhaustive boolean vectors and every zero-argument scalar member in three semantic policies. Unsupported signatures fail before compilation. Existing50 tests cover changed CSharp methods, invalid exports, source drift and edited generated outputs.
logic: Runtime source calls generated policy methods; expected stdout comes from actual CSharp reflection values, never from the generated SLG implementation. Both compiler executions must match those values.
diagnostics: Undefined enum probe is derived from current declarations; every current exported rule name is checked exactly. Invalid inputs and stale source/output rejection remain required.
